summary: A Record Go rental-company blog article explaining hybrid cars: how they switch between an internal combustion engine and electric motors, their emission and fuel-efficiency benefits, and the main hybrid types. It closes with factors to weigh before buying and a promotional list of airports and regions where hybrid rentals can be booked with Record go. The surrounding navigation, comment form, related links and cookie banner are boilerplate.
one_line: Record Go blog overview of hybrid cars covering how they work, their benefits, types, and buying considerations, with rental promotion.
key_facts: Hybrid cars combine an internal combustion engine and one or more electric motors.
Hybrid cars switch automatically between the two systems depending on driving conditions.
At low speed or standstill, the electric motor takes the lead, offering quiet, emission-free driving.
At high speed or higher power demand, the internal combustion engine kicks in and recharges the electric motor battery.
A notable benefit of hybrid cars is a significant reduction in pollutant and greenhouse gas emissions.
Hybrid cars produce fewer emissions than traditional internal combustion cars when operating in electric mode.
Parallel hybrids: both the internal combustion engine and the electric motor can power the vehicle independently or work in tandem.
Series hybrids: the internal combustion engine charges the electric motor's battery, which in turn powers the vehicle.
Plug-in hybrids let the electric motor run only for short distances, after which the internal combustion engine recharges the battery and extends range.
Factors to consider before choosing a hybrid include the type of hybrid, electric range, availability of charging stations, tax incentives and battery warranties.
Researching the maintenance and service network for hybrid vehicles is critical to ensure a smooth ownership experience.
The article was published by Record Go on Nov 3, 2023 under the categories Car rental and Car Hire.
Record go offers hybrid car rentals at airports including Alicante, Malaga, Barcelona, Madrid, Mallorca, Lisbon, Porto, Faro, Athens and Palermo.
Record go also lists car rental in Portugal, Sardinia and Sicily as destinations.
